visible_content_summary: A photograph-like view of a laptop screen shows the #ops-handover chat. Rosalind Achebe's visible 08:41 message says the freight sync failed again overnight, involved the same connector as last week, and was restarted manually. Dev Marchetti's visible 08:47 message asks how far behind the depot counts are. A later partly obscured Dev message asks whether anyone told Halvorsen depot that its counts were stale, and Rosalind's visible 07:31 reply says, 'not yet. i wanted the backfill clean first.' A broad bright glare obscures most of Rosalind's 08:52 message, the date divider, and the timestamp of Dev's later message.
